title: Sum over subsets equals a product of one plus each term
statement:
For any real numbers $c_0,\dots,c_{n-1}$, indexed by $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n$,
\[
  \sum_{S \subseteq \{0,\dots,n-1\}} \; \prod_{i \in S} c_i \;=\; \prod_{i=0}^{n-1} (1 + c_i),
\]
where the sum ranges over all subsets $S$ of the index set (with the empty product equal to $1$).
hypotheses_covered: a family of real numbers indexed by Fin n
